title: Shooting Technology Playground
description: Create a new shooting technology with playground: parametric description turning 3D assets (GLB) into icons (SVG/PNG). Two-window Model|Icon layout, camera save/load, extended scene settings (colors, sun, shadow, material), import/export toolbar, full monorepo wiring.
summary: Implemented the shooting technology with Model|Icon dual-window playground. Added shooting.fixture/v1 schema, @semio-tech/shooting-react (WorldCanvas model view + IconRenderPort SVG/PNG icon preview), @semio-tech/shooting-play controller with camera save/load, scene measures (sun/ambient/shadow/material), toolbar import/export, and full monorepo wiring (platform shooting ComponentKind, renderer bootShootingPlay host, vite registry, dev port 6019, launch.json, root scripts). Sample fixture base-icon references /mesh/base.glb. Tests pass; dev server and build verified.
